This small plot is not my own land, so I must be careful with how much money I spend on it. Still, maize needs feeding if I want a good harvest, so I will buy a small bag of NPK and some urea if the agro-dealer has it at the subsidized price — I will share from what I get for my bigger plots. I keep some manure from the goats at home and I will carry that to this plot before the rains. I cannot afford to spray chemicals, and there is no water here for irrigation, so I will rely on God and the rain, and weed by hand with my children helping.
